name: Chick-fil-A Grilled Chicken Sandwich (Plain Bun)
whyItWorks: Boneless grilled chicken breast served on a toasted white multigrain bun (or white bun upon request) without butter or mayo. Mild, non-greasy, and high in lean protein.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order "Grilled Chicken Sandwich PLAIN - no lettuce, no tomato, no pickles." Ask for a standard toasted white bun if high-fiber multigrain irritates your gut.
